RUTA RIDESHARE PLATFORM - TERMS OF SERVICE & PRIVACY POLICY

Last Updated: November 2026

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By creating an account or using the RUTA mobile application ("App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. SERVICE DESCRIPTION
RUTA is a rideshare matching platform that connects passengers with independent drivers within designated service zones. Passengers may book a solo ride or a shared ride with other passengers heading the same way. RUTA does not operate as a transportation carrier directly.

3. ACCOUNT VERIFICATION
- Every user must register with accurate details (real name, email and contact number) and verify their email address.
- To prevent fake accounts and fake bookings, registration includes a short live face check (blink, turn your head, smile) and a selfie. The selfie is used only to confirm that a real person owns the account.
- Drivers must also upload a valid license and vehicle documents, and may only go online after an admin approves them.

4. EMERGENCY CONTACTS
- Drivers must add at least one emergency (trusted) contact before they can go online.
- Passengers are asked to add a trusted contact before booking and are encouraged to do so.
- If you trigger an emergency alert, RUTA may notify your trusted contacts and share your live location with them.

5. FARES, SHARED RIDES AND RECEIPTS
- The fare is computed from distance, travel time, any time-of-day surge and any applicable discount, and is shown before you confirm a booking.
- Shared-ride fares are lower than solo fares and may be adjusted if a detour is added for another passenger.
- Payment is made directly to the driver. A digital receipt for each completed trip is sent to your registered email address.

6. SAFETY & CONDUCT
- Zero tolerance for harassment, hate speech, or dangerous behavior toward drivers or passengers.
- A passenger may use Emergency Stop during a trip. The app then asks the passenger to confirm, and later checks that the passenger and driver are safe.
- Drop-offs are confirmed only when the driver is at the drop-off point.
- Accounts violating safety rules will be suspended or permanently terminated.

7. LOCATION & DATA PRIVACY
- RUTA collects foreground and background device location to calculate routes, match drivers, show live trip status and live traffic, and confirm pick-up and drop-off.
- We store your profile, trip history, trusted contacts and verification selfie only to run the service and keep it safe.
- Personal information is handled securely and will not be sold to third parties. You may ask us to delete your account and data.

8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
RUTA is not liable for indirect damages, lost items during trips, or delays caused by traffic, road conditions or weather. Estimated arrival times and routes depend on third-party map and traffic data and may be inaccurate.
